edits_summary: CommandView.tsx: added opt-in `wrap?: boolean` prop to CommandViewProps; default behavior unchanged when wrap is undefined/false (backwards-compatible).

CommandView.tsx: when wrap=true, line style gets flexWrap:'wrap', commandText gets flexShrink:1; web-only wordBreak:'break-all' applied via Platform.OS==='web' guard to commandText, stdout, stderr, error, and legacy output Text elements so long unbroken paths/tokens wrap mid-character on web.
CommandView.tsx: native (iOS/Android) callers with wrap=true get flexWrap+flexShrink only — no wordBreak — so word-boundary wrapping is preserved on native.
SidebarBashView.tsx: removed outer <ScrollView horizontal> wrapper and the commandWrapper/scrollContent styles; now renders CommandView directly inside styles.container with wrap=true.
SidebarBashView.tsx: dropped unused ScrollView import; container style retained (flex:1, paddingTop:12).
rationale: Cycle 1 horizontal-scroll fix is mathematically correct (depth-5 ScrollView clientWidth=390 vs scrollWidth=1109 with overflow-x:auto) but UX-fail on web because the scrollbar is touch-only/hover-only and invisible at rest, so the command appears cut off with no affordance. L2 structural switch: SidebarBashView only switches from horizontal-scroll to soft-wrap by removing the ScrollView wrapper and passing the new opt-in `wrap` prop. CommandView's default (no wrap) is unchanged so BashViewFull (still wrapped in horizontal ScrollView) and CodexBashView (separate spec §5.6) keep their existing behavior. The new wrap behavior uses flexWrap+flexShrink (not flex:1) per BA constraints, and wordBreak:'break-all' is gated by Platform.OS==='web' so long paths break mid-character on the popup width.
